paper.title: Generating Long Semantic IDs in Parallel for Recommendation

source.reuse_boundary: SIDScope ships an independent MIT interoperability contract and no RPG source, weights, data, or semantic-ID cache. Users executing RPG source must comply with its non-commercial license.

source_files.evidence: OPQ semantic codes are converted to disjoint codebook vocabulary ranges; the cache name ends in .sem_ids.
The model predicts all codebooks in parallel, aggregates token log probabilities per item, and resolves through per-item graph nodes.
Default codebook, graph, backbone, and embedding configuration.
Amazon 2014 review and metadata URLs, chronological sequences, source ASIN identity, and remapped item identity.

configuration_boundary.semantic_id_construction: OPQ with one disjoint vocabulary range per codebook
configuration_boundary.model: GPT2Model with one prediction head per codebook
configuration_boundary.item_score: sum or rank-equivalent mean of per-codebook token log probabilities
configuration_boundary.decoder: random item-node frontier followed by iterative top-k graph propagation
configuration_boundary.checkpoint_boundary: Training code accepts a local checkpoint path or trains and saves a local best state dict. No checkpoint is released by the official repository.

asset_audit.raw_dataset_route: Automatic download from the Stanford SNAP Amazon Product Graph 2014 category files.

external_input_audit.dataset_license_boundary: The official code downloads SNAP-hosted Amazon Product Graph 2014 files, but no dataset license identifier is declared in the pinned RPG repository; raw files and derived row-level artifacts are not redistributed.

risks_and_blocks: No official checkpoint or precomputed .sem_ids cache is released.
The default text-embedding-3-large tokenizer route requires an API key and an OpenAI client that is not declared in the pinned requirements file.
The official graph decoder samples its initial item nodes; deterministic conformance must record or inject the initial frontier and random seed.
Identical token sets can map to multiple item nodes, so token-set resolution cannot silently collapse to one item.
The upstream code license is non-commercial and is not compatible with vendoring the implementation into SIDScope's MIT code surface without a separate boundary.
